fullContentHtml:
Download App Get Started for Free

The MHT CET 2026 Seat Allotment result for CAP Round 1 is now released by the Maharashtra CET Cell on 2nd August 2026. Candidates who have filled and confirmed their college choices can now check the seat which are allotted to them through the official portal. The allotment is prepared based on the candidate’s merit rank, category, preferences, and available seats. After checking the result, candidates should complete the seat acceptance and reporting process within the given time. Those who are not satisfied with the allotted seat can wait for the next CAP round as per the admission rules.

MHT CET Mock Test: Attempt Now

MHT CET 2026 Seat Allotment Link

The MHT CET CAP Round 1 Seat Allotment Result 2026 link has been activated on the official counselling portal. Candidates who participated in the CAP counselling and submitted their option form can now log in using their Application ID and Date of Birth to check their allotted college and course. After downloading the provisional allotment letter, candidates must complete the online seat acceptance process within the prescribed schedule. The direct link to check the MHT CET 2026 CAP Round 1 Seat Allotment is provided below.

How to Check MHT CET CAP Round 1 Seat Allotment Result?

Candidates can check their MHT CET 2026 CAP Round seat allotment result online through the official counselling portal using their login credentials. Follow the steps below to view and download your allotment letter.

Step 1 – Visit the official MHT CET CAP portal.

Step 2 – Click on the CAP Round 1 Seat Allotment Result link.

Step 3 – Enter your Application ID and Date of Birth/Password.

Step 4 – Click on the Submit/Login button.

Step 5 – Check your allotted college, course, and seat details.

Step 6 – Download and print the Provisional Seat Allotment Letter for future admission and reporting.

MHT CET Previous Year Papers PDF: Click to Download

MHT CET 2026 Seat Acceptance Process

After the CAP Round 1 seat allotment result is declared, candidates must complete the online seat acceptance process within the prescribed deadline to keep their admission active. During this process, candidates need to log in to the official portal, verify their allotted seat, and choose whether to confirm the seat or participate in the next CAP round for a better option. Candidates who are allotted their first preference seat will have their allotment automatically frozen after seat acceptance and will need to pay the prescribed seat acceptance fee through their login. Those who receive a seat other than their preferred choice can either Freeze the allotted seat if they are satisfied or choose the Not Freeze (Betterment) option to remain eligible for a better seat in the next CAP rounds while retaining their current allotment. After completing the online acceptance process and fee payment, candidates must report to the allotted institute with the required documents and admission fee to confirm their admission within the scheduled dates.

What If You Are Not Allotted a Seat in CAP Round 1?

If you are not allotted a seat in MHT CET CAP Round 1, there is no need to worry, as you can still participate in the upcoming CAP rounds. You do not need to register again, but you must fill and confirm fresh college preferences for the next round as per the schedule. The next allotment will be prepared based on your merit rank, updated choices, and seat availability. Keep checking the official counselling portal for the CAP Round 2 dates and complete all required steps within the given timeline.

MHT CET Counselling 2026: Check Full Process Here

MHT CET 2026 Institute Reporting Process

Candidates who have accepted their allotted seat must report to the allotted institute within the prescribed schedule to confirm their admission. During institute reporting, candidates need to carry all original documents, the provisional seat allotment letter, seat acceptance receipt, and pay the required admission fee. The institute will verify the documents and complete the admission process through the online system. After successful verification, the institute will issue a confirmation receipt of admission. Candidates who fail to report within the given deadline may lose their allotted seat.

Documents Required After MHT CET 2026 Seat Allotment

Candidates who have accepted their allotted seat should carry all the required original documents along with photocopies while reporting to the allotted institute. The documents will be verified before the admission is confirmed.

  • MHT CET 2026 Score Card/Rank Card
  • Provisional Seat Allotment Letter
  • Seat Acceptance Fee Receipt
  • MHT CET 2026 Admit Card
  • Class 10 Mark Sheet and Passing Certificate
  • Class 12 Mark Sheet and Passing Certificate
  • School Leaving/Transfer Certificate
  • Migration Certificate (if applicable)
  • Valid Photo Identity Proof (Aadhaar Card, PAN Card, Voter ID, Passport, etc.)
  • Domicile Certificate (if applicable)
  • Caste Certificate and Caste Validity Certificate (for reserved category candidates)
  • Non-Creamy Layer Certificate (for applicable categories)
  • EWS Certificate (if applicable)
  • PwD Certificate (if applicable)
  • Income Certificate, Defence, Minority, or other reservation-related certificates (if applicable)
  • Recent Passport-size Photographs

MHT CET 2026 Seat Allotment Important Dates

Candidates should keep track of all important counselling dates after the release of the MHT CET 2026 CAP Round 1 seat allotment result. Missing any of these deadlines may result in the cancellation of the allotted seat.

Event Date
CAP Round 1 Seat Allotment Result 2 August 2026
Online Seat Acceptance (Freeze/Not Freeze) 3 August to 5 August 2026 (up to 3:00 PM)
Reporting to Allotted Institute & Admission Confirmation 3 August to 5 August 2026 (up to 5:00 PM)
Display of Vacant Seats for CAP Round 2 6 August 2026
CAP Round 2 Option Form Submission & Confirmation 7 August to 9 August 2026

MHT CET Seat Allotment 2026 Result

Official Portal to Publish All Future Updates

The Maharashtra CET Cell will publish all updates regarding Round 2 registration, vacant seats, option form filling, seat allotment, and reporting schedules only on the official CAP portal. Candidates should regularly check the website to avoid missing important counselling deadlines.

Updated on: 05 Aug 2026 | 03:50:38 PM IST

Round 2 Offers Another Admission Opportunity

Candidates who are not allotted a seat in Round 1 or wish to secure a better college can participate in CAP Round 2. The next round will be conducted based on vacant seats remaining after Round 1 admissions.

Updated on: 05 Aug 2026 | 03:40:25 PM IST

Institute Reporting Required After Acceptance

Candidates who successfully accept their allotted seat must report to the allotted institute with all original documents and admission fees for final verification and confirmation. Missing the reporting deadline may lead to forfeiture of the allotted seat.

Updated on: 05 Aug 2026 | 03:30:48 PM IST

Grievance Option Available Online

If a candidate notices any discrepancy in their claim or uploaded documents after seat allotment, they can submit an online grievance through the candidate login during the prescribed period. Offline requests will not be entertained by the CET Cell.

Updated on: 05 Aug 2026 | 03:20:54 PM IST

Self-Verification Mandatory After Allotment

Candidates must complete the self-verification process through their login after accepting the allotted seat. They must confirm that the category, reservation, marks, and uploaded documents submitted during registration are accurate before proceeding with admission.

Updated on: 05 Aug 2026 | 03:10:35 PM IST

Vacant Seat List to Be Released Next

After completing the Round 1 admission process, the Maharashtra CET Cell will publish the vacant seat list for CAP Round 2. Candidates planning to participate in the next round should regularly monitor the official counselling portal for updates.

Updated on: 05 Aug 2026 | 03:00:28 PM IST

Around 43,900 Seats Still Vacant

Even after the release of the CAP Round 1 Seat Allotment, nearly 43,910 engineering seats remain vacant. These seats are expected to be available during the upcoming CAP counselling rounds, giving another opportunity to eligible candidates.

Updated on: 05 Aug 2026 | 02:50:49 PM IST

Over 16,600 Candidates Got First Preference

The Maharashtra CET Cell has confirmed that 16,615 candidates received their first-preference institute in CAP Round 1 through the Auto Freeze mechanism. Candidates should now proceed with seat acceptance and institute reporting as per the official schedule.

Updated on: 05 Aug 2026 | 02:40:13 PM IST

Auto Freeze Applied for First Preference

Candidates who received their first-choice college and branch under the Auto Freeze option will have their allotment automatically confirmed. Those satisfied with their allotment should complete the remaining admission formalities before the reporting deadline.

Updated on: 05 Aug 2026 | 02:30:24 PM IST

Round 1 Admission Confirmation Begins

Candidates allotted seats in MHT CET 2026 CAP Round 1 must complete online seat acceptance and report to their allotted institutes between August 3 and August 5, 2026. Failure to complete the admission process within the deadline may result in cancellation of the allotted seat.

Updated on: 05 Aug 2026 | 02:20:29 PM IST

CAP Round 2 Registration After Round 1

Candidates who do not receive a satisfactory allotment in Round 1 can participate in the next counselling phase. The Maharashtra CET Cell will announce the CAP Round 2 schedule after completing the Round 1 admission process.

Updated on: 05 Aug 2026 | 02:10:29 PM IST

Keep Original Documents Ready

Candidates should keep their MHT CET scorecard, Class 10 and 12 mark sheets, domicile certificate, category certificate, identity proof, and other required documents ready for institute reporting and admission verification after seat acceptance.

Updated on: 05 Aug 2026 | 02:00:22 PM IST

CAP Round 1 Cut-Offs Released

Along with the seat allotment, the MHT CET 2026 CAP Round 1 Cut-Offs have also been published. Candidates can compare the closing ranks of various colleges and branches to estimate their chances in the upcoming counselling rounds.

Updated on: 05 Aug 2026 | 01:50:29 PM IST

Over 1.57 Lakh Candidates Allotted Seats

According to the Maharashtra CET Cell, more than 1.57 lakh candidates have received seat allotments in CAP Round 1. The allotment was prepared based on merit rank, reservation policy, seat availability, and candidates’ option form preferences.

Updated on: 05 Aug 2026 | 01:40:55 PM IST

Choose Betterment Option if Seeking Higher Preference

Candidates allotted a college other than their first preference can select the Not Freeze option to participate in the next counselling round for betterment while retaining the currently allotted seat.

Updated on: 05 Aug 2026 | 01:30:06 PM IST

Report to Allotted Institute After Acceptance

Candidates accepting their allotted seat must report to the allotted institute with the required original documents and admission fee within the prescribed schedule to confirm their admission under CAP Round 1.

Updated on: 05 Aug 2026 | 01:20:17 PM IST

Check Allotment Using Login Credentials

Students can check their MHT CET Seat Allotment 2026 by visiting the official portal and entering their Application ID and Date of Birth. The allotment letter contains details of the allotted institute, branch, category, and reporting instructions.

Updated on: 05 Aug 2026 | 01:10:29 PM IST

Seat Acceptance Window Open

Candidates allotted a seat in CAP Round 1 must complete the online seat acceptance process by August 5, 2026 (3:00 PM). They must choose the appropriate option—Freeze or Not Freeze (for betterment)—through their login to continue the admission process.

Updated on: 05 Aug 2026 | 01:01:06 PM IST

MHT CET CAP Round 1 Seat Allotment 2026 Out

The MHT CET 2026 CAP Round 1 Seat Allotment Result has been released by the Maharashtra CET Cell. Candidates who participated in the counselling process can now check their allotted college and branch by logging into the official CAP portal using their Application ID and Date of Birth.

Updated on: 05 Aug 2026 | 12:59:39 PM IST

MHT CET 2026 Seat Allotment FAQs

Q1. Is the MHT CET 2026 Seat Allotment Result released?

Yes, the MHT CET 2026 CAP Round 1 Seat Allotment Result was released on 2 August 2026.

Q2. How can I check my MHT CET CAP Round 1 Seat Allotment 2026?

You can check the allotment result by logging in to the official CAP portal using your Application ID and Date of Birth/Password.

Q3. What should I do after the MHT CET 2026 Seat Allotment?

You must accept the allotted seat online and report to the allotted institute within the given schedule.

Q4. Can I participate in the next CAP round after seat allotment?

Yes, candidates can choose the Not Freeze (Betterment) option to be considered for a better seat in the next CAP rounds.

Q5. What documents are required for MHT CET 2026 admission after seat allotment?

Candidates need to carry the allotment letter, scorecard, admit card, educational certificates, photo ID, and applicable reservation documents.
